en-US.description: A chat-first desktop AI assistant, all in chat
en-US.longDescription:
Use it as an everyday chat app; hand it a folder and it gets to work — reading code, editing files, running commands. It can also handle repetitive chores on a schedule, and you can keep chatting from your phone when you're away from your computer.

✨ Highlights

🗣️ All in Chat
Just say it in the chat: create a persona, set up a scheduled task, remember a habit, mount a folder… No digging through settings — click confirm and it's done.
🎭 Multiple personas, each with a specialty
Ships with Deva, an all-round assistant, and 小码酱 (Xiaomajiang), a security research expert. Create your own too — each with its own personality, avatar and preferred model.
🤖 Subagents, multi-agent dispatch
Big tasks get split up and dispatched to multiple subagents running in parallel — or in the background when the result isn't needed right away. Four built-in types — General, Explore, Research and Plan — each with its own context, returning only the conclusions.
⏪ Broke something? Roll it back
/rewind to before any turn. Code and conversation can be restored separately, and a rewind can itself be undone.
⏰ Scheduled tasks
Create a task with one sentence; it runs on time and notifies you when done. Supports daily, weekly, monthly and cron.
📱 Keep chatting in IM
Connect your favorite chat app. Away from your computer, messages from your phone go straight to Deva on your desktop.

zh-CN.description: 对话优先的桌面 AI 助手，All in Chat
zh-CN.longDescription:
平时当聊天工具用；给它一个文件夹，它就能直接动手——看代码、改文件、跑命令。还能帮你定时做些重复的事，人不在电脑前，也能用手机接着聊。

✨ 亮点

🗣️ All in Chat
要做的事都在对话里说一句：建角色、建定时任务、记住习惯、挂载文件夹……不用翻设置页，你点个确认就办好。
🎭 多角色，各有所长
内置全能助手 Deva 和安全研究专家小码酱；也能自己建角色，每个都有独立的性格、头像和常用模型。
🤖 子智能体，自动派发多 Agent
大任务自动拆开，派给多个子智能体并行跑，不急着要结果的还能放到后台；内置通用、检索、调研、方案四种，各有独立上下文，只把结论交回来。
⏪ 改坏了能退回去
/rewind 回到任意一轮之前，代码、对话可分开恢复，回退了还能撤销。
⏰ 定时任务
一句话建任务，到点自动跑，跑完弹通知；支持每天、每周、每月、cron。
📱 IM 里接着聊
把常用的聊天工具接进来，人不在电脑前，用手机发消息就是在电脑上的 Deva 里对话。
zh-CN.name: Deva
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
本版距 v0.1.14 较近，重点调整模型的默认上下文窗口与压缩时机。标称 1M 上下文的模型在上下文很长时会出现重复输出、无法正确响应等问题。模型标称的窗口不等于实际能用好的长度，这个版本参考 Codex 的做法收紧了默认值。
This release follows v0.1.14 closely and focuses on default context windows and compaction timing. Users reported that models advertising a 1M window may start repeating output such as end when the context gets long. A nominal window is not the length a model handles well, so following Codex, the defaults are now tighter.
上下文与压缩 / Context & Compaction
- 默认上下文窗口下调：非 Claude 模型的自动窗口默认为 256K，压缩会更早触发，避免模型在超长上下文中出现复读、输出退化。Claude 模型不受影响 / Smaller default context window: the automatic window for non-Claude models is capped at 256K, so compaction kicks in earlier and avoids repetition and degraded output in very long contexts. Claude models are unaffected
- 需要大上下文可手动选择：在模型设置中选择上下文窗口即可，不受上述上限限制；可选 128K、200K、256K、400K、512K（新增）、1M / Pick a larger window when needed: choose a context window in model settings to bypass the cap. Options: 128K, 200K, 256K, 400K, 512K (new) and 1M
- 压缩后真正变短：压缩后保留的最近内容不超过 4 万 token，大窗口模型压缩后不会仍剩下几十万 token / Compaction actually shrinks: the recent history kept after compaction is capped at 40K tokens, so large-window models no longer keep hundreds of thousands of tokens
- 压缩结果把关：摘要出现大段重复，或压缩后并没有变短时，放弃本次结果，避免白白丢失原文细节 / Summary guards: a summary with long verbatim repeats, or one that is not shorter than the original, is discarded so details are not lost for nothing
- 复读检测：回复陷入逐字重复时自动丢弃重试，仍然重复则截断停止；子智能体、项目成员和定时任务将其记为失败，不再当作正常结果 / Repetition detection: when a reply falls into verbatim repetition it is discarded and retried, then trimmed and stopped if it persists; subagents, members and scheduled tasks report it as a failure
- 完整对话记录：压缩不再删除界面上的消息，被压缩的轮次仍可查看，也仍可回退 / Full transcript: compaction no longer removes messages from the chat; compacted turns stay visible and rewindable
新功能 / New Features
- 引用消息：在聊天区选中文字后右键「引用」，内容以引用形式放在输入框上方，发送时附在消息开头；代码块保留语言与缩进 / Quote messages: select text in the chat and right-click "Quote" to attach it above the composer; it is prepended to your message on send, and code blocks keep their language and indentation
- 子智能体默认后台运行：派出后主对话可以继续，同一轮派出的多个子智能体全部结束后统一汇报 / Background subagents by default: the main conversation keeps going, and subagents dispatched in the same turn report back together once all finish
问题修复 / Bug Fixes
- 修复服务商默认输出预留过大、超出上下文窗口导致长对话请求被拒的问题；出现时会自动改为显式输出预算后重发 (#43) / Fix long conversations being rejected when the provider's default output reservation exceeds the context window; Deva now retries with an explicit output budget (#43)
- 定时任务列表：任务名过长时截断显示，已完成的一次性任务不再显示暂停按钮 / Scheduled tasks: truncate long task names and hide the pause button for completed one-shot tasks
- 禁止内置浏览器中的网页修改应用图标角标 / Block web pages in the built-in browser from setting the app icon badge
致谢 / Thanks
感谢 @ailianyiren（#41）、@leizh007（#41、#42、#43）的反馈与建议 / Thanks to everyone above for their feedback and suggestions.
完整变更 / Full Changelog: https://github.com/sqfcyily/deva/compare/v0.1.14...v0.1.15
